Senses.Explanation: Running into the exposed pillar is a collision image that masters turn into a warning and a verdict: the obstruction is standing in plain sight, yet the person meets it blindly. Xuedou calls the Silla visitor a blind fellow who ran into the pillar. Dahui warns the assembly not to collide with it when the lamps go out and repeats the warning after a pillar saying; Caotang Shanqing asks where the collision occurs; Zhulang Chesheng makes avoiding the pillar one of his rules for the assembly; Zixian Jue invokes the blind collision while rejecting a stock appraisal; Yulin Tongxiu makes the stone base itself shout the phrase.
